podcast.body: This album by Squeeze was produced by Elvis Costello, who was returning a favor to Squeeze frontman Glenn Tilbrook after Tilbrook provided counterpoint vocals on Costello's "From a Whisper to a Scream." This collaboration highlights the reciprocal relationships between artists in the early 1980s new wave scene. "Costello produced Squeeze's own 1981 album, East Side Story."
